test_specification.kernel_guard: Per-trial admission_rates and admission_bursts; protective trials intentionally drop excess noise before NFQUEUE.

collector_control: Process census disabled throughout; NFQUEUE20ms only in diagnostics. Scheduler accounting enabled only where explicitly recorded.

setup_failures_before_noise.cause: Offline check rejection status2 for an obfuscation packet was treated as a command failure. Shared helper now accepts expected codes0/2 and rejects other failures. Original failed capture preserved.
The first four captured packets contained no eligible transport. Removed packet-count cutoff; capture remains bounded by four seconds. Old capture retained.

interpretation_limits: 70-second noise trials with 60-second TCP; not continuous hours-long endurance.
One offered noise tuple and two fixed fixtures; distributed/adaptive multi-flow attacks not tested.
Protective admission drops excess before NFQUEUE; legitimate high-PPS clients share the same limits and aggregate budget.
Native Linux clients only; isolated source-IP/port rebinding tested once, GUI clients and real public-IP changes not tested.
Host scheduling and full-system load remain part of this QEMU/WHPX lab.
Exit authenticates all VPN data; partial header admission is not peer authentication.
Kernel trace identifies client-origin outer packet drops, not the exact encrypted packet of each missing inner ICMP sequence.
